payload.reason: The evidence discusses the exploration of hyperparameters in neural network systems, particularly in relation to word embeddings and their performance in various tasks.

claims.text: Hyperparameters explored include the combination of vector dimension size and corpus size.
The performance of different architectures of word or sub-word embeddings is also a focus for future research.
The evaluation of hyperparameters is linked to their impact on downstream tasks like Named Entity Recognition and Sentiment Analysis.
